# WhatsBackUp

> A free Windows desktop archive for WhatsApp messages and media, plus images
> imported from ChatGPT and Gemini. Files live on the user's PC, with optional
> AI organisation and media copies to a chosen cloud or network folder.

Site: https://whatsbackup.cc/
Source: https://github.com/tasty-foods/whatsbackup
Current application version: 1.4.5
Website updated: 9 September 2026
Primary audience: small businesses that use WhatsApp for daily work, with dedicated
paths for personal memories and creators collecting AI images. The homepage uses
an illustrative 3D archive, a gather/find/check story, optional local audio and
visitor-controlled motion. These demonstrations use sample content.
Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit.
Price: the app is free. Optional AI provider charges and limits apply.

## Sources

- WhatsApp: saves new photos, videos and message text while the app runs.
  Documents, voice notes, audio and stickers can be enabled. Import history
  collects media still available in linked chats; unavailable files cannot be recovered.
- ChatGPT: imports uploaded and generated images from conversations. Reads chats
  before downloading, reports progress, and retries temporary failures with backoff.
- Gemini: imports generated images from the account's Library.
- Each source has a separate connection. ChatGPT and Gemini use separate local
  browser profiles; the user signs in directly with the respective service.

## Tools

- Optional AI albums, conversation projects and search using image labels and
  recognised text. Manual corrections persist. The user supplies a provider key,
  accepts the data notice, reviews an estimate and sets a monthly budget.
- Media copy checks verify presence and matching sizes in a configured folder.
  Checks expire. They do not verify full file contents or remote cloud uploads.
  The cloud client handles uploads. Message data remains in a local SQLite database.
- Cleanup suggests possible duplicates and small images for review. Duplicate
  candidates use file size and a partial fingerprint, not a full-content comparison.
  Quarantine is reversible; permanent deletion is a separate action.
- Status Studio optionally schedules WhatsApp statuses from a queue, watched
  folder or album, with templates and optional AI writing. Off by default, behind
  consent and initially in dry run, with quiet hours and posting limits.
- Search saved conversations and export readable HTML transcripts.

## Latest improvements in 1.4.5

- Each fallback-chain row that needs an API key carries its own key box; the
  key is saved against that provider and encrypted with the Windows account.
- The per-row model box refuses anything shaped like an API key and says where
  the key belongs, so a key is never written to the settings file in the clear.
- From 1.4.4: sources say what they import, where photos are saved and how many
  there are; a chat outside the address book is shown by its number.

## Limits and privacy

- This is a browsable desktop archive, not a phone restore backup.
- Capture, imports and scheduling require the app to be running.
- No WhatsBackUp account or developer archive-hosting service.
- Linked sources use their respective services. Optional AI sends selected
  content to the configured provider; Status Studio can post to WhatsApp.
- Source browser profiles hold sign-in sessions and must be kept private.
- Cloud copies and exports must be managed separately when removing data.
- The software is independent and unofficial, with no affiliation to WhatsApp,
  Meta, OpenAI or Google. Services may change or restrict unofficial connections.
- The installer is unsigned. Review its source and Windows security prompts.
- The source code is public. This page makes no claim about a particular licence.
